outcome_definition: Final grade <=64 is failure; NOT the <70 ML class boundary
sample_selection: All 65 randomized students in published Table 4; counts transcribed from JATS and checked against rendered PDF
missing_policy: No imputation; use published complete 2x2 counts; raw missingness unknown
model: descriptive counts and failure risk ratio only; Barnard p not recomputed
interval_algorithm: none: no CI claimed or added
software_original: scipy for Barnard test, version not specified; not relevant to exact count/RR arithmetic
